relationships.subject: recent life adversity
relationships.evidence_quote: In parallel models there was a statistically significant relationship between a greater number of RLA events of moderate or greater severity and a higher inflammatory cytokine composite score (p = 0.036)

relationships.subject: early life adversity
relationships.evidence_quote: a greater number of ELA events of moderate or greater severity showed a trending relationship to higher levels of the TLR-4 inflammatory cytokine composite score (p = 0.067)

relationships.subject: recent life adversity
relationships.evidence_quote: There were no significant associations between exposure to ELA, RLA, or cumulative adversity of at least moderate severity and either cortisol slope or night cortisol

key_findings: In women with IC/BPS, recent and cumulative life adversity associated with higher LPS/TLR4-stimulated cytokine composites
No association of adversity or inflammation with diurnal cortisol
